daedalus.api 0.1.8
text: patch version introduces choice behavioural model user-facing label ‘Change public behaviour’ (PR #49). Updated model_run.R pass user-specified behavioural response choice daedalus::daedalus(); uses ‘new’ behavioural model via daedalus::daedalus_new_behaviour(); Adds small exported function help process behavioural response choice; note mapping users’ behaviour choice parameter \(\bar B\) reversed (“low”: high optimism, less protective behaviour; “high”: low optimism, protective behaviour). default behavioural effectiveness \(\delta\) = 0.2, responsiveness parameter \(k_2\) = 0.01. Updates API return behaviour choice descriptions (added via internal function), updates metadata display file show options; Updates mock data, tests model_run.R changes daedalus v0.2.36 .

title: daedalus.api 0.1.6
text: patch version updates cost results outputs (PR #47). Updates function get_nested_costs() JSON schema scenarioCosts.json return costs array metric-value pairs; allows costs expressed different units. Updates results schema scenarioResults.json return age-specific VSL countries. Updates metadata schema return metric value costs multiple units. Added results list names time-series names package constants. Moved cost_item() function inline helper internal package function. Updates tests helper functions; added helper tests nested list outputs R/tests.R.
